title: Make Codex context hooks restore state and report native usage
body: Operator asked for working Codex hooks and context control equivalent in purpose to the existing Claude integration, then explicitly reassigned the current lead to this work while another instance may verify the CI design. Implement and qualify the result; do not stop at another audit.

Evidence: the codex-context recon (left the checkout; quoted below) and ../ci-infrastructure/codex-context-audit.md. Source owner is GLOBAL krn-works/krn-codex-skills, verified base 58c46090c08168b45a4b6dd2690318fdc8235a10. Its local main d273159c is clean but diverged (four local commits); preserve it and use an isolated worktree at a freshly verified owner base.

Deliver:
1. Fix capsule recovery so oversized JSON/Unicode/multiple outcomes cannot silently discard the entire restart context. Emit bounded useful pointers and an explicit truncation/diagnostic signal. Existing real receiver lost a 5161-byte envelope at its 4096-byte cap; shortening capsule data gave a 1549-byte PASS, without fixing the general defect.
2. Add Codex-native usage gauge/advisories on its actual events, using last-request/main-chain metadata, never cumulative session sums or the Claude parser. Distinguish KRN's 120k/160k advisory policy from the actual model window (observed475000), reset/deduplicate correctly across compaction, and report missing/stale counters honestly. Do not change model_context_window, auto-compaction limits, models or MCP.
3. PreCompact saves a bounded state-check receipt (UTC, outcome ids/status/exit) under .krn; it must not invent a capsule or block compaction accidentally. SessionStart startup/resume/compact restores current state from files and reports degraded state safely. Preserve KRN adoption boundaries for every event and write; unrelated projects get no KRN workflow.
4. Keep hook definitions/helpers owned by source and the existing release/installer. Preserve Herdr and disabled state; never edit an immutable installed release or synthesize trusted_hash/bypass trust.

Acceptance: native metadata captures and focused meaningful tests reproduce the old failures by assertion and pass at the exact head; independent review and owner gates pass; accepted source is sealed/installed under recorded grants; real Codex runtime0.166 discovery/trust and callbacks are observed, including advisory, PreCompact receipt and restoration after controlled compaction. Manual handler output and unit tests alone are not runtime acceptance. Record actual output limits, error paths and non-adopter no-op.

Authority: the operator explicitly requested hook configuration/repair. Prior install/seal authority is recorded in continuous-delivery/handoff.md and state.md; reuse it. The earlier exact Claude-hook trust does not automatically cover new Codex definitions. Prepare/review the concrete handlers first, then obtain only any required separate exact hook-trust grant. No credentials, production host changes or external CI setup are needed.

Related t-rperync is Claude-specific and remains open; t-zkepy2m owns source/release exposure and t-9v5sb1z installer idempotence. Do not silently replace their acceptance or broaden this into a model/profile/MCP overhaul. CI is separate P0 t-crxrfg4 and its handoff is already written.

Progress (PR codex-hooks): repository-local Codex hooks shipped in .codex/hooks.json + scripts/codex/context-hook.ts (SessionStart restart block via shared restartText, UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse usage advisory from last_token_usage.total_tokens of the rollout at transcript_path, PreCompact receipt that the hook writes into its codex precompact run directory). Evidence, codex-cli 0.167.0: hooks feature stable; events seen in the Codex UI: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, PreCompact, Stop. Verbatim SessionStart payload: session_id, transcript_path (rollout jsonl), cwd, hook_event_name, model, permission_mode, source; no usage in payloads. Usage lives only in the rollout: event_msg token_count with last_token_usage (total_tokens) and model_context_window (475000 observed); total_token_usage is cumulative (17.5M in a real session) and must not be used; first token_count has info:null; compaction writes a type:compacted line followed by a token_count whose last_token_usage.input_tokens is 0 but total_tokens is the post-compaction estimate. Project-local .codex/hooks.json is NOT run until trusted (verified: untrusted hooks silently skipped); trust is written into global config, so runtime acceptance (trust, real advisory, PreCompact receipt, compact restore) still needs the separate exact hook-trust grant. Not done: owner-side capsule oversize fix (global krn-codex-skills krn_capsule.py 4096-byte all-or-nothing cap); the repo-local path here truncates with an explicit marker instead. Task stays open.

2026-11-08 research (t-cz92be6): the generated SessionStart input schema in openai/codex (codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated) lists the sources startup, resume, clear, compact and fork, and core queues a compact source after compaction; KRN's .codex/hooks.json matcher has no fork. Check the matcher and the hook stdout against schemas pinned per receiver version (RP-08 in .krn/runs/lead/external-patterns/lanes/ext-repos.md). Re-injecting a mechanical identifier index after compaction is a measurable restore candidate (PA05 in ext-papers.md).

Codex-context recon, quoted 2026-11-08 from the recovery copy: Codex 0.165.0 on PATH, app-server 0.166.0. Usage: rollout `event_msg/token_count`, `payload.info.last_token_usage` plus `model_context_window` (sample input 244319, window 475000). Cumulative `total_token_usage` is not current context. The app server emits `thread/tokenUsage/updated`, `hook/started`, `hook/completed`, and `hooks/list` for discovery. Installed `krn_capsule.py` handles PreCompact as a no-op and drops any SessionStart output over 4096 B (a 5161 B capture was lost). The owner is `krn-works/krn-codex-skills`, base `58c46090c08168b45a4b6dd2690318fdc8235a10`. Missing: a native usage parser, a PreCompact state-check write, a live trust or callback readback (`hooks/list` got no reply in 8 s), and tests for trust and for the 4096 B overflow.

Grant 2026-11-09: the operator trusted the Codex hooks of .codex/hooks.json in the global Codex config ("Hookom zaufałem"); runtime acceptance (live trust readback, advisory, PreCompact receipt, compact restore) is unblocked.

Runtime acceptance 2026-11-09, codex-cli 0.167.0, `codex exec` in the main checkout with the trusted .codex/hooks.json (four trusted_hash entries in ~/.codex/config.toml). Captures under .krn/runs/codex/acceptance/. SessionStart: the rollout holds a developer message with content_item_kinds hooks.additional_context and provenance hook:true carrying the KRN restart block (1340 B, under the 4096 B cap) next to the global krn_capsule.py block (781 B). UserPromptSubmit: the first prompt wrote context-gauge {"highest":0} (no token_count yet, so no advisory). Controlled compaction (`codex exec resume <id> -c model_auto_compact_token_limit=20000`, one invocation, config unchanged): PreCompact wrote .krn/runs/codex/precompact/<id>.json {"at":"2026-11-09T13:54:46.232Z","head":"01bd8ba","claims":[],"exit":0}; the gauge re-armed at the compacted boundary (total 28173); the restart block was re-injected after compaction. Advisory: a 633 KB prompt took the last request to 257458 input tokens; the next UserPromptSubmit injected 220 B "Context at 257k (KRN advisory 120k/160k; model window 475k). ... run krn-handoff ..." and recorded highest 160000. Remaining owner/trust items moved to t-9zd1ev0.
